description: This file contains localization data and utility functions for Bulgarian (Bulgaria) date and time formatting and parsing, customizing the Date.js library to support Bulgarian culture-specific formats, names, and patterns.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of the date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time component of the date object to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the current date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date with another date object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on its name in Bulgarian or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specified year.
